title: SphericalDreamer: Generating Navigable Immersive 3D Worlds with Panorama Fusion
claim: From a short text prompt, our method generates diverse, fully immersive worlds that can be navigated over long distances.
layout: 2 rows: large panorama with camera path on top, five thumbnails below
description: The figure is a gallery of generated samples. In the top-left, a prompt box reading 'Generate a forest.' has an arrow down to a bold 'SphericalDreamer' box, which has an arrow pointing right. This leads to a wide, distorted 360-degree panorama of a green forest with a stream. Four camera icons are joined by a dashed white curved path across the panorama, with the label 'immersive navigation'. Along the bottom, five equal-sized views from other generated worlds are captioned with italic prompt completions: an underwater world, a martian desert, a jungle, a desolated land and a grass field. The eye goes first to the large lush forest panorama, then to the row of varied environments. A pale blue background holds everything together.
caption: SphericalDreamer. Our method generates diverse 3D worlds from textual prompts, enabling immersive navigation over long distances. The bottom row illustrates views encountered during the exploration of generated environments (see [ref] for full prompts). Results are best appreciated as videos; see our project page at \url{https://sphericaldreamer.github.io/}.
abstract: The generation of immersive and navigable 3D environments is increasingly prevalent with the growing adoption of virtual reality and 3D content. However, recent methods face a fundamental limitation: they cannot produce 3D worlds that simultaneously (i) are navigable over long-range spatial extents and (ii) cover the complete omnidirectional field of view ($360^\circ$ horizontally and $180^\circ$ vertically). To address this challenge, we introduce SphericalDreamer, a method for generating fully immersive and long-range 3D outdoor environments from textual prompts. Our approach is built on the generation of multiple panoramic images, which are subsequently lifted into 3D and fused together while maintaining visual and geometric consistency. SphericalDreamer produces highly detailed, fully immersive 3D environments, while substantially improving scale and navigability compared to prior approaches.
